ValidationRule.description: Account owners are able to remove a store they own from a chain.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(ParentId), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $UserRole.Name <> 'Field Analyst', OR( TPB_Parent_Account_Name__c = 'HQ - Unassigned Chain Retailers', ISBLANK(ParentId) ), PRIORVALUE(TPB_Parent_Account_Name__c) <> 'HQ - Unassigned Chain Retailers', NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(ParentId))), NOT(PRIORVALUE(Parent_Owner__c)), TEXT(Status__c) = 'Open' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please first ensure you are the current chain owner, then you can remove or change.
